emptyBody: You can still file an RTI with any central government office on the official RTI Online portal.
explain: An RTI is a letter that asks a government office for information it holds. We have {n, plural, one {# ready-made letter} other {# ready-made letters}} for {district}: pick a topic, copy the letter, and file it online.
timelineSimple: The RTI Act, 2005 gives every step a time limit. If a limit passes, you can move to the next step.
tl1Body: Send it with the application fee to the Public Information Officer (PIO) of the office. People below the poverty line (BPL) pay no fee.
tl2Body: The PIO must reply within 30 days, or within 48 hours when a person's life or liberty is at stake.
tl3Body: No reply, or not happy with it? Appeal to the First Appellate Authority, a senior officer in the same office.
tl4Body: Still no answer? Appeal to the {commission}, or to the Central Information Commission for central government offices.
